definitions.gloss: to push forward, to advance, to promote
definitions.explanation: To actively advance or promote something, such as a plan, policy, or reform. Implies determined effort to make progress.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{改革|かいかく}を{押|お}し{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The government is pushing forward with reforms.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}はデジタル{化|か}を{積極的|せっきょくてき}に{押|お}し{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The company is actively promoting digitalization.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{押|お}し{進|すす}めるには{予算|よさん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need a budget to push the plan forward.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from {押|お}す (to push) + {進|すす}める (to advance). The compound emphasizes forceful or determined advancement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{改革|かいかく}を{押|お}し{進|すす}める (push forward reforms)
・{計画|けいかく}を{押|お}し{進|すす}める (advance a plan)
・{政策|せいさく}を{押|お}し{進|すす}める (promote a policy)
・{事業|じぎょう}を{押|お}し{進|すす}める (push forward a business)

USAGE: Often used in formal or business contexts. Implies active, sometimes aggressive promotion of initiatives.
